hooks.name: Security review reminder on writes
hooks.description: Before file-writing tools run, reminds to check SSRF guards and authz boundaries per security steering when editing fetch/extraction/auth code.

action.prompt: If this write touches remote-fetch, AI extraction, auth, or state-transition code, verify it follows .kiro/steering/security.md: SSRF allowlist + private/link-local IP blocking + redirect re-validation + timeout/size caps; authz boundaries (community code cannot set verificationStatus); reporter identity never exposed publicly. If not relevant, proceed without comment.
